title: Native acceptance can blame a stale dirty run when the current source cannot be measured
outcome: A refused native acceptance request names the run and source condition that actually decides the refusal, without offering a commit-and-rerun remedy for a stale dirty registration.
acceptance: A behavior regression covers an older dirty native registration alongside a newer selecting run, and an unavailable owner capture; neither case blames the stale native run.
NativeLocalChanges is returned only when the deciding native candidate and a measured dirty current source justify it; all source and admission fences remain effective.
